title: 第7章 惶恐的赵龙第8章 新来的美女
content_zh:
张逸风走远之后，小施的声音传来：“齐老，你还真留他的电话，一个小子能知道什么呼吸吐纳之法。多半是信口胡诌。不信你让他和我比试比试，我一只手就能将他放倒。”
“小施，这些事情我宁可信其有，不可信其无。对了，你去查查张逸风，这个名字倒是有些耳熟。”
“是的，齐老。”
……
张逸风并不知道老者正在派人调查他，就算知道，他也毫不在意。他给老者的呼吸吐纳之术，并不是修真界的法术，修真界的法术必须依靠灵气引导，他是修改了一下再交给老者的，但就算是修改了一下，老者想要掌握估计也不容易，那一股“气”，极难把握，能不能掌握，完全靠他的天赋。这就是他只给了老者一部分口诀的原因。
离开小竹林，张逸风回到别墅，换了一套衣服就出门了，他身上几万块钱，应该能买一些药材和炼制符篆的材料。
两个世界虽然有不同，但也相通之处，那就是天地造化，万物有灵，只是地球的灵，要稀薄得多而已。但用来炼制低等级的符篆，应该够了。
购买材料，花了张逸风整整一天的时间，四万多元，只剩下了两千元。有一些药材，价格不低。
接下来的日子，张逸风一直把自己关在房间里，大门不出二门不迈，至于学校，更是去都没去。
就在张逸风闭关的第五天，于超裹着绷带回来了，他带了一大群小混混到处找张逸风，可惜张逸风像是人间蒸发了。
不少同学都认为张逸风是害怕于超，躲了起来，又或者，吓得直接辍学了。
除却于超的事情外，经开大学还有一件事情让广大男同胞非常兴奋，那就是经开大学又转来了一位女神。童颜巨ru，俏皮可爱。
“别提张逸风的事情了，我听说经济系三班又来了一位女神，扎着马尾辫，打扮青春靓丽，好想将她扑倒，抱在怀里啊！”
“哎，为什么女神都去了别的系，我电力工程系怎么这么苦逼。不过，传言可信吗？真的很漂亮？同经开大学十大美人比起来怎么样？”
“应该能进入前十，当然，比起林思颖这等级的美女来，还是差了点什么。林思颖才是我的梦中女神。”
“梦中女神？我看是梦遗对象吧。”
校园里，不少男同学都在谈论新转来的校花，忽然，一位同学发出一声惊呼。
“快看，那不是于超吗？”
视线中，一位上半身缠着绷带的青年坐在石座椅上，眼神阴沉，嘴里骂骂咧咧，此人正是于超。
于超心情极其不爽，前几日被张逸风打断了肋骨，硬生生在病床上躺了三天，一出院，他就去找了自己的大哥肖冰，肖冰非常仗义，虽然自己没有亲自前来，却给他安排了五个人，帮他出这口气。

虽然只有五个人，但这五个人可不是一般的小混混，这五人身材高大，肌肉发达，是肖冰的专用打手。能借给他用几天，也算照顾他这位小弟了。
五位保镖一般的魁梧汉子跟在身后，肖冰走在校园里，那可是虎虎生威，面上倍有光芒，走起路来更是嚣张，好像整条道都是他的。
可惜，肖冰来势汹汹想给张逸风一个教训，张逸风却一直不在学校。
这一日，于超又来找张逸风了。
“超哥，还是没有找到。张逸风似乎一直没有回学校。”
于超的两位跟班从一旁跑了过来。
“这难道真的躲起来不上学了？”于超气得直咬牙，这种有力无处使的感觉，简直太让人不爽了。他就是要给张逸风一个教训，让张逸风知道在这个校园里，他于超是狼不是羊。
如果这口气不出，他今后还怎么泡妹子？那些妹子怎么能服他！
content_en:
After Zhang Yifeng walked away, Xiao Shi's voice came: "Mr. Qi, you really left his phone number. How can a kid know how to breathe and exhale? It's probably just nonsense. If you don't believe it, let him compete with me, and I can knock him down with one hand."
"Xiao Shi, I would rather believe that these things happen than not believe that they don't exist. By the way, go look up Zhang Yifeng. This name sounds familiar."
"Yes, Mr. Qi."
…
Zhang Yifeng didn't know that the old man was sending people to investigate him. Even if he knew, he didn't care. The breathing technique he gave the old man was not a spell in the world of cultivation. The spells in the world of cultivation must rely on the guidance of spiritual energy. He modified it before giving it to the old man, but even if he modified it, it would not be easy for the old man to master it. That "qi" is extremely difficult to grasp. Whether he can master it depends entirely on his talent. That's why he only gave the old man part of the formula.
After leaving the small bamboo forest, Zhang Yifeng returned to the villa, changed into a set of clothes and went out. He had tens of thousands of dollars on him, which should be able to buy some medicinal materials and materials for refining talismans and seals.
Although the two worlds are different, they also have something in common, that is, the creation of heaven and earth, and everything has animism, but the spirit of the earth is much thinner. But it should be enough for refining low-level talismans.
It took Zhang Yifeng a whole day to purchase materials, more than 40,000 yuan, and only 2,000 yuan was left. There are some medicinal materials that are not cheap.
In the following days, Zhang Yifeng kept himself locked in his room, never leaving the door or even going to school.
On the fifth day of Zhang Yifeng's retreat, Yu Chao came back wrapped in bandages. He brought a large group of gangsters everywhere to look for Zhang Yifeng. Unfortunately, Zhang Yifeng seemed to have disappeared from the world.
Many students thought that Zhang Yifeng was afraid of Yu Chao and hid, or he was so scared that he dropped out of school.
In addition to Yu Chao's incident, there is another thing that makes the male compatriots very excited about Jingkai University, and that is that Jingkai University has transferred another goddess. She has a childish face, cute and cute.
"Forget about Zhang Yifeng, I heard that there is another goddess in Class 3 of the Economics Department. She has a ponytail and is dressed youthfully and beautifully. I really want to throw her down and hold her in my arms!"
"Hey, why have all the goddesses gone to other departments? Why is my electrical engineering department so miserable? But are the rumors credible? She is really beautiful? How does it compare with the top ten beauties of Jingkai University?"
"She should be able to enter the top ten. Of course, she is still a little behind compared to beauties of Lin Siying's level. Lin Siying is the goddess of my dreams."
"The goddess in my dream? I think she is the object of a wet dream."
On campus, many male students were talking about the newly transferred school beauty. Suddenly, a classmate let out an exclamation.
"Look, isn't that Yu Chao?"
In sight, a young man with a bandage on his upper body was sitting on a stone seat, his eyes were gloomy and he was cursing. This person was Yu Chao.
Yu Chao was in an extremely unhappy mood. His ribs were broken by Zhang Yifeng a few days ago and he lay on the hospital bed for three days. As soon as he was discharged from the hospital, he went to find his elder brother Xiao Bing. Xiao Bing was very generous. Although he did not come in person, he arranged for five people to help him vent his anger.
Although there are only five people, these five people are not ordinary gangsters. These five people are tall and muscular. They are Xiao Bing's special thugs. If you can lend it to him for a few days, you can take care of his little brother.
With five burly men who looked like bodyguards following behind him, Xiao Bing walked on campus. He looked very powerful, his face was shining, and he walked even more arrogantly, as if the entire road belonged to him.
Unfortunately, Xiao Bing came aggressively and wanted to teach Zhang Yifeng a lesson, but Zhang Yifeng was never in school.
On this day, Yu Chao came to see Zhang Yifeng again.
"Brother Chao, we still haven't found him. Zhang Yifeng seems to have never returned to school."
Yu Chao's two followers ran over from the side.
"It's difficultIs Tao really hiding and not going to school? "Yu Chao was so angry that he gritted his teeth. This feeling of having no power to use was simply too unpleasant. He just wanted to teach Zhang Yifeng a lesson and let Zhang Yifeng know that in this campus, he, Yu Chao, is a wolf, not a sheep.
If he doesn't say this, how will he pick up girls in the future? How could those girls convince him!
